reviewPolicy.maintenance: Manually review dispositions and current-roster identity matches before publishing updates

incidents.summary: Police arrested Pearce after a reported domestic dispute. Prosecutors later filed felony aggravated-battery-with-a-deadly-weapon, fleeing/eluding, and resisting-with-violence charges, plus a misdemeanor stalking charge.
incidents.disposition: Pearce agreed to a six-month pretrial intervention program. His attorneys said all felony and misdemeanor charges would be dismissed if he completed it without a violation.

discipline.description: Eight-game suspension for violating the personal conduct policy

sources.label: Associated Press — diversion agreement and filed charges
NFL — eight-game personal-conduct suspension

incidents.summary: A woman alleged in 2024 that Prescott sexually assaulted her in 2017. Prescott denied the allegation and filed a separate civil action alleging extortion.
incidents.statusLabel: No criminal charge; civil claim dismissed
incidents.disposition: Dallas police said detectives found insufficient evidence that an offense occurred and did not pursue charges. A judge later dismissed the accuser's civil lawsuit.
incidents.denial: Prescott denied the allegation and alleged an attempted extortion.

sources.label: ESPN — police decline charges for insufficient evidence
Reuters — civil lawsuit dismissed

incidents.summary: More than two dozen women accused Watson in civil filings of sexual assault or other sexual misconduct during massage appointments. Watson denied wrongdoing.
incidents.statusLabel: No indictment; civil cases settled or dismissed
incidents.disposition: Two Texas grand juries declined to indict Watson. Many civil matters were settled, and Associated Press reported in February 2026 that the final two related lawsuits had been dismissed.

discipline.description: Eleven-game suspension, $5 million fine, evaluation, and treatment requirements under a league/NFLPA settlement

incidents.denial: Watson has denied assaulting anyone and denied wrongdoing in the civil matters.

sources.label: Associated Press — final related lawsuits dismissed and case history
NFL — 11-game suspension and $5 million fine

incidents.summary: Police arrested Jacobs on recommended domestic-abuse-related offenses including battery, victim intimidation, and felony strangulation or suffocation.
incidents.disposition: The district attorney released Jacobs while seeking more investigation and said no formal charging decision had been made. A July update said the investigation remained open.
incidents.denial: Jacobs, through counsel, denied wrongdoing and said the evidence would support no charges.

sources.label: Associated Press — arrest, release, denial, and open investigation
WTMJ — July 2026 investigation status

incidents.summary: Video showed Hunt shoving and kicking a woman during a February 2018 altercation. The league also cited a separate June physical altercation.
incidents.statusLabel: NFL conduct finding; no criminal charge
incidents.disposition: NFL reporting said Hunt was not arrested and faced no criminal charge for the February incident. The league imposed discipline for both physical altercations.

discipline.description: Eight-game suspension for violating the personal conduct policy

sources.label: NFL — eight-game suspension and underlying incidents

incidents.summary: Judkins was arrested after his girlfriend alleged that he struck her during a July 7 car ride from the Fort Lauderdale airport.
incidents.statusLabel: Prosecutors declined to file a charge
incidents.disposition: Broward County prosecutors declined the misdemeanor battery case, citing no video or independent witnesses, a delayed report, and evidence issues they said made conviction unlikely.

sources.label: Associated Press — prosecutors decline domestic-violence case
NFL — arrest allegation and police report

incidents.summary: Rice's former girlfriend alleged in a civil lawsuit that he repeatedly assaulted her between December 2023 and July 2025, including while she was pregnant.
incidents.statusLabel: Civil allegation; no NFL policy finding
incidents.disposition: The NFL later said it found insufficient evidence of a personal-conduct violation and imposed no discipline for these allegations. The cited reports did not identify a criminal charge.
incidents.denial: Rice denied the lawsuit allegations through counsel.

sources.label: Associated Press — civil assault allegations
People — NFL closes review with no discipline

incidents.summary: Rice drove at high speed in a Dallas street race, caused a multi-vehicle crash that injured people, and left the scene.
incidents.statusLabel: Guilty plea to two third-degree felonies
incidents.disposition: Rice pleaded guilty to collision involving serious bodily injury and racing on a highway causing bodily injury. He received deferred probation, 30 days in jail, and restitution obligations.

discipline.description: Six-game suspension for violating the personal conduct policy

sources.label: Associated Press — guilty plea, sentence, and crash facts
Associated Press — six-game NFL suspension

incidents.summary: Bateman was accused of smashing a vehicle window while the mother of his child and their infant were inside; shattered glass allegedly caused small facial cuts.
incidents.disposition: Georgia court records listed family-violence battery, reckless conduct, and first-degree criminal damage to property. NFL reporting said the league was reviewing the matter in August 2026.
incidents.denial: Bateman's attorney said the matter had been taken out of context and urged people to await the legal process.

sources.label: NFL — arrest, charges, and alleged injuries
ESPN — August 2026 NFL review and case status

incidents.summary: Worthy was arrested after an allegation of assaulting a household member by impeding breathing or circulation, a third-degree felony allegation under Texas law.
incidents.disposition: The Williamson County district attorney declined to accept the case after reviewing witness interviews. Worthy was released and no criminal charge was pursued.
incidents.denial: Worthy's attorneys called the allegation baseless and said he had been the target of extortion.

sources.label: Associated Press — arrest, denial, and declined charges

incidents.summary: Cooper was arrested twice in June after a dispute with his girlfriend. Filed counts include felony second-degree assault by strangulation and misdemeanors tied to the dispute and an alleged protection-order violation.
incidents.disposition: Cooper pleaded not guilty. Reuters reported in late July that the matters had been combined and that an arraignment was scheduled for August 31, 2026.

sources.label: NFL — second arrest and alleged protection-order violation
Reuters — pending felony charge and August arraignment

incidents.summary: Green said an anonymous sexual-assault accusation preceded his suspension at Virginia and transfer to Marshall.
incidents.disposition: ESPN reported that Green was never charged. Green denied wrongdoing, and the Ravens said they investigated the allegations before drafting him.
incidents.denial: Green denied the allegation and said he had done nothing wrong.

sources.label: NFL — Green addresses and denies the allegations
ESPN — Ravens review and no criminal charge

incidents.summary: A former live-in chef accused Diggs of slapping and choking her during a dispute. Prosecutors charged felony strangulation and misdemeanor assault and battery.
incidents.disposition: A jury found Diggs not guilty of both charges on May 5, 2026, after a two-day trial.
incidents.denial: Diggs denied that the assault occurred and pleaded not guilty before his acquittal.

sources.label: Associated Press — not-guilty verdict and trial record

incidents.summary: Jones was arrested after two loaded firearms were found in his carry-on luggage at Boston Logan International Airport, leading to serious gun charges.
incidents.disposition: Prosecutors dropped the gun charges after Jones agreed to one year of pretrial probation and 48 hours of community service on other counts.

sources.label: ESPN — weapons charges dropped and agreement terms

incidents.summary: An Uber driver accused Winston of nonconsensual sexual touching during a ride in Arizona.
incidents.disposition: The NFL said its investigation concluded Winston touched the driver in an inappropriate and sexual manner without consent. The discipline was negotiated and Winston did not appeal.

discipline.description: Three-game suspension for violating the personal conduct policy

sources.label: NFL — investigation finding and three-game suspension

incidents.summary: Police found Williams's registered handgun under his seat during a traffic stop. He lacked a concealed-pistol license at the time, and police submitted a concealed-weapon warrant request.
incidents.disposition: The Wayne County prosecutor denied the warrant because Michigan law did not support a charge on the specific facts. The NFL later imposed no discipline.

sources.label: Wayne County Prosecutor — no charges and legal rationale
ESPN — no criminal charge or NFL discipline

incidents.summary: A woman reported a violent domestic incident involving an NFL player; reporting and the ensuing investigation connected the matter to Flowers.
incidents.statusLabel: No charge; NFL found insufficient evidence
incidents.disposition: Baltimore County police suspended the investigation without charging Flowers. The NFL said there was insufficient evidence of a personal-conduct violation and took no action.

sources.label: ESPN — no charge and NFL insufficient-evidence finding

incidents.summary: Humphrey was arrested and charged with felony robbery after a dispute with an Uber driver over a phone charger valued at $15.
incidents.disposition: A judge dismissed the robbery charge after finding no probable cause that Humphrey had committed a crime.
incidents.denial: Humphrey said the event was a misunderstanding and that he believed the charger was his.

sources.label: ESPN — felony charge dismissed for no probable cause
NFL — arrest report and Humphrey's account

incidents.summary: Bond surrendered on a sexual-assault warrant in Texas and was released on bond. He denied the allegation.
incidents.statusLabel: Grand jury returned no bill; case closed
incidents.disposition: A Collin County grand jury returned a no bill, meaning no indictment would issue. The district attorney said the decision concluded the criminal proceeding.
incidents.denial: Bond denied the allegation and filed a separate federal complaint alleging false accusations and coercion.

sources.label: ESPN — no bill and criminal case closed
NFL — surrender, denial, and no-bill disposition

incidents.summary: Mixon punched a female student in the face during an altercation, causing facial fractures. Surveillance video was later released publicly.
incidents.disposition: Mixon entered an Alford plea, received a deferred sentence, community service, and counseling, and did not serve jail time.

discipline.description: Suspended from football for the entire 2014 season

sources.label: CBS News/AP — assault plea, injuries, and season suspension
ESPN — Mixon's public apology for the assault

incidents.summary: Sneed was accused in connection with shots fired at two men at a Texas auto dealership. Reporting described an initial aggravated-assault charge that was reduced to failing to report a felony.
incidents.disposition: The remaining failure-to-report charge was dropped in May 2026. Reuters reported that a related civil lawsuit remained pending at that time.

sources.label: Reuters — criminal charge dropped and civil-case status
ESPN — charge history and dismissal

incidents.summary: Kamara was arrested after a man was beaten outside a Las Vegas nightclub and initially faced felony battery resulting in substantial bodily harm.
incidents.disposition: Kamara pleaded no contest to misdemeanor breach of peace; the felony count was resolved in the plea agreement. He received community service and paid the injured man for medical bills.

discipline.description: Three-game suspension for violating the personal conduct policy

sources.label: NFL — no-contest plea and reduced charge
NFL — three-game personal-conduct suspension

incidents.summary: Hill was accused of choking and assaulting his then-pregnant fiancée while he was at Oklahoma State.
incidents.statusLabel: Guilty plea to domestic assault and battery by strangulation
incidents.disposition: Hill pleaded guilty in 2015 and received three years of probation.

sources.label: Associated Press — guilty plea and sentence
